caption:
does gua sha actually lift your face?

It can change how your face looks this morning. That is a different claim from lifting.

Massage can briefly move fluid and raise blood flow, so the outline may look sharper for a while. A change that is gone by lunch and tissue that has actually lifted are not the same promise.

The lunch test: note the time you finish, then look again at lunch. If it has faded, call it de-puffing. It is still a nice ritual.

General education only.
